label: verify-bm-funding-materials

claims.claim: NSF 26-521 and 26-515 are rolling, posted 17 Aug 2026; 26-521 allows 1 proposal per person per fiscal year, 26-515 has no per-PI limit; 26-521 covers Biomaterials/Polymers etc., 26-515 covers AMDO/MAMS.
claims.source_says: "Proposals Accepted Anytime"; 26-521: no more than one proposal per fiscal year per PI/Co-PI; 26-515: "There are no restrictions or limits." Both posted August 17, 2026.
claims.note: All parts reproduce; the 'lowest-barrier' ranking is the agent's judgment but the facts hold.

claims.claim: DMREF is 1.5-2.0M over 4 years, last window 21 Jan-4 Feb 2025, biennial in odd years, no 2027 solicitation found; NSF Future Manufacturing closed with a replacement promised for FY 2026 but not found.
claims.source_says: "Awards are expected to range from $1,500,000 – $2,000,000 over ... four years"; "biennially in odd-numbered years"; window "January 21, 2025 - February 04, 2025"; FM: "plan to issue a new NSF funding opportunity ... in FY 2026".
claims.note: Page lists 25-508 as latest, consistent with no 2027 solicitation; 'not found' is the agent's own search result.

claims.claim: Nearest dated UK/EU deadlines: NMIP Sandpit 26 Nov 2026 (UK research orgs), ERC Consolidator 12 Jan 2027, Innovate UK Investor Partnerships 19 Jan 2027 (UK SMEs), EIC Pathfinder Open Stage 1 25 Feb 2027 (up to EUR 4M, 3-country consortium); UK ones exclude a US-only team.
claims.source_says: Sandpit "Closes: 26/11/2026 4:00pm", UK research organisation required; Investor Partnerships "Closes: 19/01/2027 11:00am", UK-registered SME; ERC "Deadline: 12 January 2027"; EIC Stage 1 25 February 2027.
claims.note: EIC consortium needs three entities in member/associated states, not strictly 'three countries' stated so, but close; the ERC/EIC host rules were not tested beyond that.

claims.claim: Autodesk Foundation is invite-only, Schmidt takes no unsolicited proposals, Simons MPS LOI closed 29 Oct 2026, Sloan and Holcim could not be used; only Graham (25 Feb 2027 for organisations) is open.
claims.source_says: Schmidt: "do not accept unsolicited proposals." Autodesk: "Each year we invite a small selection of organizations". Simons LOI "October 29, 2026". Graham orgs "Feb 25, 2027"; individuals page inconsistent (sidebar passed, body Sept 15, 2026).
claims.note: Autodesk, Schmidt, Simons and Graham dates check out; Sloan and Holcim were not checked, and 'only Graham is open' is a judgment (Graham Carter Manny 15 Nov 2026 is also open).

overall: All four key claims are factually supported against live pages except for minor unchecked parts (Sloan, Holcim). The agent's quotes largely reproduce; MAMS wording elsewhere in the file differs from the page ('deformation and failure') but is not in the key claims.
